roha.intro.en: Type a request, use a button, or enable voice.
roha.intro.am: ጥያቄ ይጻፉ፣ አዝራር ይጠቀሙ ወይም ድምጽን ያብሩ።

roha.request.en: What would you like help with?

roha.stopped.en: Stopped. You can continue when you are ready.

roha.notUnderstood.en: I could not do that. Try “bigger text”, “read page”, or use the buttons.
roha.notUnderstood.am: ይህን ማድረግ አልቻልኩም። “ትልቅ ጽሑፍ” ይበሉ ወይም አዝራሮቹን ይጠቀሙ።

roha.aiConsent.en: Allow my typed requests to be sent to the configured AI provider. Do not include passwords, ID numbers or private support details.
roha.aiConsent.am: የጻፍኳቸው ጥያቄዎች ወደ ተመረጠው የኤአይ አቅራቢ እንዲላኩ እፈቅዳለሁ። የይለፍ ቃላትን፣ የመታወቂያ ቁጥሮችን ወይም የግል ድጋፍ ዝርዝሮችን አያካትቱ።

roha.voiceNotice.en: Your browser may send audio to its speech service. You can type instead.
roha.voiceNotice.am: አሳሽዎ ድምጽን ወደ ድምጽ አገልግሎቱ ሊልክ ይችላል። በምትኩ መጻፍ ይችላሉ።

roha.providerChanged.en: AI settings changed. Open AI options and review them before continuing.
roha.providerChanged.am: የAI ቅንብሮች ተቀይረዋል። ከመቀጠልዎ በፊት የAI አማራጮችን ከፍተው ይመልከቱ።

roha.actionUnavailable.en: I could not make that change. Try another control.
roha.actionUnavailable.am: ይህን መቀየር አልቻልኩም። ሌላ አዝራር ይሞክሩ።

roha.voiceWelcome.en: Roha voice enabled. How can I help you on this page?
roha.voiceWelcome.am: የሮሃ ድምጽ በርቷል። በዚህ ገጽ በምን ልርዳዎት?

roha.voiceUnsupported.en: Voice recognition is not supported in this browser. You can type or use the keyboard.
roha.voiceUnsupported.am: ይህ አሳሽ ድምጽን ወደ ጽሑፍ አይቀይርም። መጻፍ ወይም አዝራሮችን መጠቀም ይችላሉ።

roha.microphoneEnabled.en: Microphone enabled. You can speak now.

roha.microphoneDenied.en: Microphone permission was denied. You can use text and keyboard controls.
roha.microphoneDenied.am: ማይክሮፎኑን ለመጠቀም ፈቃድ አልተሰጠም። መጻፍ ወይም አዝራሮችን መጠቀም ይችላሉ።

roha.microphoneUnavailable.en: Could not access microphone. Text and keyboard controls are ready.
roha.microphoneUnavailable.am: ማይክሮፎኑን ማግኘት አልተቻለም። መጻፍ ወይም አዝራሮችን መጠቀም ይችላሉ።

roha.microphonePermission.am: ከመናገርዎ በፊት ማይክሮፎኑን ለመጠቀም ፈቃድ ይስጡ።

roha.voiceInputError.en: Voice input did not work. You can still use text or keyboard.
roha.voiceInputError.am: የድምጽ ግቤቱ አልሠራም። መጻፍ ወይም አዝራሮችን መጠቀም ይችላሉ።

roha.proposedAnswer.en: I heard "{value}". Would you like to keep this, or change it?
roha.proposedAnswer.am: «{value}» ሲሉ ሰማሁ። ይህን መልስ ማቆየት ወይስ መቀየር ይፈልጋሉ?

roha.resumeComplete.en: All questions are filled and ready for your review.
roha.resumeComplete.am: ሁሉም ጥያቄዎች ተሞልተዋል። መልሶችዎን መመልከት ይችላሉ።

roha.orientationComplete.en: You are on {title}. All {total} questions are completed and ready for final review.
roha.orientationComplete.am: በ«{title}» ገጽ ላይ ነዎት። ሁሉም {total} ጥያቄዎች ተሞልተዋል። መልሶችዎን ይመልከቱ።

roha.orientationProgress.en: You are on {title}. We are on question {step} of {total}: "{question}". You have answered {answered} of {total} questions.
roha.orientationProgress.am: በ«{title}» ገጽ ላይ ነዎት። ከ{total} ጥያቄዎች በ{step}ኛው ላይ ነን፦ «{question}»። ከ{total} ጥያቄዎች {answered} መልሰዋል።

roha.aiDisabled.en: AI is disabled. You can use the local controls.
roha.aiDisabled.am: AI ጠፍቷል። በመሣሪያዎ ላይ ያሉትን አዝራሮች መጠቀም ይችላሉ።

roha.barrierUnderstand.en: I will explain this simply. This question asks for: "{question}". We can read it aloud or use simpler words.
roha.barrierUnderstand.am: በቀላል ቃላት ላስረዳዎ። ይህ ጥያቄ "{question}" ይጠይቃል። ገጹን ጮክ ብለን ማንበብ ወይም ቃላቱን ማቅለል እንችላለን።

roha.barrierRead.en: You don't need to read the screen. I can read each question aloud to you, or enlarge the letters.
roha.barrierRead.am: ስክሪኑን ማንበብ አያስፈልግዎትም። እያንዳንዱን ጥያቄ ጮክ ብዬ አነብልዎታለሁ ወይም ጽሑፉን አተልቃለሁ።

roha.barrierDocument.en: Standard national ID is not required. You can choose a Refugee ID, Kebele letter, or our no-document partner referral route.
roha.barrierDocument.am: የብሔራዊ መታወቂያ የግድ አያስፈልግም። የስደተኛ መታወቂያ፣ የድጋፍ ደብዳቤ፣ ወይም ያለመታወቂያ በአጋር የመመራት አማራጭ መምረጥ ይችላሉ።

roha.barrierType.en: You don't have to type. You can tap the microphone and speak your answer, or ask someone to help you.
roha.barrierType.am: መተየብ አያስፈልግዎትም። ማይክሮፎኑን ተጭነው መልስዎን መናገር ይችላሉ፣ ወይም ደጋፊ ሰው እንዲያግዝዎ መጠየቅ ይችላሉ።

roha.barrierHelper.en: Someone helping you is fully supported. We will record learner consent, and you will review all answers before anything is submitted.
roha.barrierHelper.am: ረዳት ሰው እንዲያግዝዎ ሙሉ በሙሉ ይፈቀዳል። የተማሪው ፈቃድ ይመዘገባል፣ እና ምንም ነገር ከመላኩ በፊት እርስዎ መልሶችዎን ይመለከታሉ።

roha.barrierOffline.en: Your answers are safely preserved on this device. You will not lose your work, and the form will submit automatically once connected.
roha.barrierOffline.am: መልሶችዎ በዚህ መሣሪያ ላይ በሰላም ተቀምጠዋል። የሠሩት ስራ አይጠፋም፤ ግንኙነት ሲመለስ በራሱ ይላካል።

roha.barrierPrivacy.en: You have full control over your privacy. Support needs are optional, and you can select "Prefer not to say".
roha.barrierPrivacy.am: የግል መረጃዎ ሙሉ በሙሉ በእጅዎ ነው። የድጋፍ ፍላጎቶች አማራጭ ናቸው፣ እና "መግለጽ አልፈልግም" የሚለውን መምረጥ ይችላሉ።

roha.barrierGeneral.en: Roha is here to help. Would you like me to explain the question simply, read it aloud, or suggest a permitted next step?
roha.barrierGeneral.am: ሮሃ ለማገዝ ዝግጁ ናት። ጥያቄውን በቀላል ቃላት እንዳስረዳዎት፣ ጮክ ብዬ እንዳነብልዎ፣ ወይም ወደ ቀጣይ ደረጃ እንድንሄድ ይፈልጋሉ?

roha.reviewEmpty.en: No answers have been recorded yet.

roha.reviewIntro.en: Here are all your recorded answers:

roha.reviewFooter.en: You can say "change my [field]" or "submit" when you are ready.
roha.reviewFooter.am: ማንኛውንም መልስ ለመቀየር መጠየቅ ወይም ማረጋገጥ ይችላሉ።

roha.resumeLink.en: OpenPath / Roha: Use this secure link to continue your application: {url}. Valid for {hours} hours. Never share this link.
roha.resumeLink.am: OpenPath / ሮሃ፦ ማመልከቻዎን ለመቀጠል ይህን አገናኝ ይጠቀሙ፦ {url}። ለ{hours} ሰዓታት ይሠራል። አገናኙን ለሌላ ሰው አያጋሩ።

roha.resumeInvalid.en: Resume link is invalid or has already been used.
roha.resumeInvalid.am: የመቀጠያ አገናኙ አይሠራም ወይም አስቀድሞ ጥቅም ላይ ውሏል።

roha.resumeExpired.en: This resume link has expired. Please start a fresh application.
roha.resumeExpired.am: የዚህ መቀጠያ አገናኝ ጊዜ አልፏል። አዲስ ማመልከቻ ይጀምሩ።

roha.smsFailed.en: The text message could not be sent. Please try again.

roha.supportRequested.en: Learner requested direct assistance with this step
roha.supportRequested.am: ተማሪው በዚህ ደረጃ የሰው እርዳታ ጠይቋል።

roha.supportFailed.en: Could not contact the support service. Please try again.
roha.supportFailed.am: የእርዳታ አገልግሎቱን ማግኘት አልተቻለም። እንደገና ይሞክሩ።

roha.partnerConsent.en: I confirm that this partner helped me fill this form with my permission, and I have reviewed every answer before sharing.
roha.partnerConsent.am: ይህ አጋር በፈቃዴ ይህንን ቅጽ እንድሞላ እንደረዳኝ እና ከማጋራቴ በፊት እያንዳንዱን መልስ እንደገመገምኩ አረጋግጣለሁ።
